x: Fletcher had a good day, taking away no less than three prizes, whilst Sid King took his first prize since staging a "come-back." Speechley maintains his improved form and this season looks like being the best of many for him.

Syd King, an old-timer, and when turning out salvage recently, passed his news-cuttings and records on to the Hon. Secretary, who found them very interesting and will in turn pass them on to the Club Historian.
He hopes (?) to visit us more frequently. Sid King, another "old 'un," complete with R.W.A. Gold Medal and push bike, was an onlooker (shame!) at the Open Walk.
George Tyrer, our oldest cross-country runner, looked in at the Hall recently. Syd King has been out training again; it looks as if we are going to see some old faces in our post-war teams.
Naturally the entry was not very big and the race was won by our Track Captain, in the fast time of 14.19 with Syd King 2nd and Joe Scamell 3rd.
We must also pay tribute to the great help given our walkers by Syd and Mrs. King, Joe Coleman, Jack Goswell, Frank Elson, Percy Wright and many others throughout the race.
